text.title: Ads Attribution Models Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure for Ads Attribution Models: the five generic steps, then GA4 attribution configuration, the variance check, and the human-in-loop checkpoints that steps 4-5 expand into. Each step lists input, action, output, and a decision-gate to the next step.

step.name: inventory-inputs
step.input: task brief, prior artefact (if any), source-of-truth access
step.action: Collect inputs named in AGENTS.md Prerequisites table; verify access; capture timestamps.
step.output: Inputs index with source citations; access blockers surfaced.
step.decision-gate: All inputs reachable? If no -> skip per AGENTS.md Skip If.

step.name: apply-rules
step.action: Walk each rule in `01-core-rules.xml`. Verify each is satisfied. Note violations.
step.decision-gate: Any rule-violation that blocks the methodology? If yes -> skip OR remediate before continuing.

step.name: walk-decision-tree
step.action: Open `06-decision-tree.xml`. Evaluate root question and traverse branches until a `<conclusion>` is reached.
step.output: Decision-record-style note: branch path + conclusion + rule id referenced.
step.decision-gate: Decision = skip-this-methodology? If yes -> log skip reason and exit. Else -> continue.

step.name: draft-artefact
step.action: Draft per `02-output-contract.xml`. Fill schema-required fields. Anchor every non-trivial field to >= 1 evidence entry.
step.output: Draft artefact (JSON or Markdown sidecar matching schema).
step.decision-gate: All required fields populated? Evidence cited? If no -> iterate.

step.name: validate-and-handoff
step.action: Run `scripts/validate-ads-attribution-models.py --file <artefact>`. Resolve violations. Set status to ready_for_review. Notify named consumer.
step.output: Validator OK + status=ready_for_review + handoff note delivered.
step.decision-gate: Validator exit 0? Consumer acknowledged? If no -> fix and re-validate.

section.title: GA4 attribution configuration (expands step 4)

step.name: configure-ga4-attribution
step.input: Locked source of truth (one-locked-source-of-truth rule), sales cycle length
step.action: Admin → Attribution settings → Reporting attribution model: Data-driven. Lookback window: 30-90 days (match to sales cycle). Acquisition conversion events: configure explicitly
step.output: GA4 attribution settings recorded in the artefact settings block.
step.decision-gate: Lookback window matches the measured sales cycle (lookback-matches-cycle rule)? If no -> iterate.

step.name: variance-check
step.input: Platform-reported, GA4-modeled, warehouse-deduped conversions per channel
step.action: Run `templates/variance-check.py`; present all three numbers per channel; flag any pair diverging by more than 15%.
step.output: Weekly variance report with alert flags and named reviewer.
step.decision-gate: Any channel flagged? If yes -> investigate before any budget decision (variance-threshold-15 rule).

section.reference: Python helper that computes platform-vs-warehouse and GA4-vs-warehouse divergence per channel and sets alert flag above 15%

step.name: human-checkpoints
step.input: Draft artefact, proposed budget or model changes
step.action: Budget reallocation > 10% of total spend: human approval required. Change of canonical attribution model: human approval required. Retroactive re-attribution of historical conversions: snapshot first, human approval required. New geo-holdout test design: human approval required before budget changes execute.
step.output: Named approvals recorded in the artefact evidence; snapshot reference for any re-attribution.
step.decision-gate: Every triggered checkpoint has a named human approval (human-signoff-thresholds rule)? If no -> do not execute the change.
